data.text: The Navy is keeping tight lipped about the cause of the fire aboard the amphibious transport dock ship, USS New Orleans achonored in Okinawa, Japan, that is now out. Two minor injuries reported. No word on the extent of the damage except to indicate that at least some of the crew will be berthed elsewhere for now and that additional support is being provided to the vessel and crew. We laughed at China for losing two ships in a single incident last week. Guess who's going to be laughing now? The New Orleans is a critical vessel in supporting operations to defend Taiwan and the Philippines. There are only 11 other vessels like it. China knows how critical these ships are to our deterrence and defense missions in the Asia-Pacific. I wouldn't rule out Chinese-sponsored sabotage until told otherwise at this point
